text:
Maria V: Heads-up — I pushed a config preview for a new `route_by_region` flag and in dry-run it shows weird quota spikes for EU customers. Can someone sanity-check the schema/validation?
Kevin L: link to preview?
Maria V: https://console/internal/configs/preview/route_by_region (dry_run=true). Repro: set percent=30, region_weights: {eu:70, na:30} and we see token spikes for eu routes in the telemetry.
Jamal: I can take a look. Quick q: is the preview actually routing traffic or just simulating?
Maria V: dry_run=true should simulate only, but the preview profiler shows KV cache miss increase and the quota dashboard picks up requests as if they hit EU pool.
Sasha: Could be our side-effecting validator calling the router during schema check. We had that before with the `quota_probe` helper.
Kevin L: If validation triggers short-running probe pings, dry-run might still increment some counters. We intentionally avoided touching pool metrics during validation, but maybe a regressed helper snuck in.
Jamal: I'll grep for `quota_probe` in the preview path.
deploy-bot: deploy/preview-452 -> successful, preview route config applied (dry_run=true) by maria.v at 1729801123
Maria V: thanks. If validation is non-idempotent we should fail closed in preview mode. We don't want telemetry to be polluted.
Sasha: Agreed. Proposal: Two changes — 1) make runtime config validation pure (no side effects), 2) add a telemetry-gate to preview that marks metrics with `preview=true` tag so dashboards ignore them by default.
Kevin L: For (2) we also need a migration path for existing metrics. Adding `preview=true` tag for new metrics is fine but old ones will remain noisy. We can add a rollup filter in the console to exclude preview-tagged series from billing/alerts.
Jamal: Implementation detail: the validation pure refactor will require replacing `quota_probe` with a dry-read that uses model of the routing decision, not network calls. I can mock the decision logic.
Maria V: Also UX idea: in console when users open a preview we should show a clear badge: "This preview is simulated — metrics here are annotated" and a toggle to include/exclude preview metrics in the timeline.
Sasha: +1. Also add a safety check: if preview.percent > 50% warn that preview is dangerously high. (We had a mis-click once that set percent=80 and an infra job accidentally decreased capacity.)
Kevin L: We should also clamp preview percent to max 40% by default unless `requires_approval=true`. That prevents accidental large sim cohorts.
Jamal: On rollout API side, recommend making `dry_run` orthogonal to `preview_cohort_percent`. `dry_run=true` ensures no side effects. `preview_cohort_percent` only marks simulated sampling for telemetry. Small sample = 5% by default.
Maria V: Sounds good. Can we add schema-level constraints: `preview_cohort_percent` type: int 0-100; `dry_run` boolean; `requires_approval` boolean. If `preview_cohort_percent` > 40 and `requires_approval` is false -> validation error with remediation link.
Sasha: Validation error should include a machine-actionable code to allow the console to show a CTA that opens an approval flow. e.g. `ERR_PREVIEW_TOO_LARGE`.
Kevin L: For telemetry gating, backend will annotate traces and metrics with `config.preview_id` and `preview=true`. Also add `preview.parent_config` to group multiple previews.
Jamal: I'll open a small RFC for the pure-validator change and include the `quota_probe` removal. Also will submit a tiny migration to backfill `preview=false` for any metrics created by earlier previews so dashboards default to ignoring them.
Maria V: Thanks. Who wants the console changes? Need the preview badge, toggle, and the warning modal for >40%.
Sasha: I'll handle console UI. Will add a small A/B: show the toggle in expert mode first.
Kevin L: I'll update the server-side schema and gating, add the `ERR_PREVIEW_TOO_LARGE` code, and add server tests.
Jamal: ETA for server-side: EOW for the validator refactor + tests. Console ETA: next sprint for badge and toggle. Migration ticket filed: MIG-2026.
Maria V: PTAL at the preview logs I attached in the preview link — Jamal let me know if you want me to disable the preview now.
Jamal: Disable for now, I'll run the grep and revert the preview flag.
deploy-bot: preview/452 -> reverted by jamal at 1729801560
Maria V: Reverted. Thanks all. I'll wait for the RFC and schema PR before re-running. :thumbsup:
Sasha: Once PRs land we should run a smoke test suite that asserts no preview metrics hit billing pipelines. I can add that to the CI playbook.
Kevin L: Good call. Add a telemetry smoke test that flips `dry_run=true` and asserts no metric increments in billing stream for 5s.
Maria V: OK closing the loop: schema PR requested in #repo-config, RFC in docs/rfcs/preview-validator.md — will ping when ready.
